parity_reason: No criterion differs by more than 1 point, the totals are 31 and 30 (a difference of 1), and neither image has a critical defect, so parity holds.

reference.summary: Santa rides a kick scooter fast across a snowy hill at night under a full moon, with a stack of wrapped presents beside him and speed lines behind him; the drawing is lively and clear, but the presents are not supported.

defects.what: The stack of presents floats in the air next to Santa; it is not held and does not rest on the deck
defects.where: the gift stack on the left of Santa
defects.expected: The presents are clearly carried by Santa or sit firmly on the scooter deck

defects.what: Santa's outstretched arm cuts across the bottom present, so the shapes overlap untidily
defects.where: Santa's left arm and the green present
defects.expected: The arm and the presents are layered so that it is clear which is in front

defects.what: The hat's tail is very long and rigid and sticks up and back like a horn
defects.expected: The hat tail flops or flutters naturally behind Santa's head

attempt.summary: Santa rides a kick scooter on a snowy hill at night under a full moon, holding a wrapped present, with a gift sack on the deck; the drawing is clean and readable, with a few stiff proportions.

defects.what: The scooter deck is very long and wide, so it looks more like a flat cart than a kick scooter
defects.expected: The deck is sized like a scooter deck, just long enough for the rider and his sack

defects.what: Santa's body faces the viewer instead of the direction he is riding
defects.expected: Santa's body is turned toward the handlebar and the direction of travel

defects.what: Santa's head and hat are big compared with his short torso and stubby legs
defects.expected: Santa's head, body and legs look balanced for a cartoon figure

defects.what: The present in Santa's hand sits at an awkward angle and overlaps his arm, so it is hard to see how he grips it
defects.where: Santa's left hand and the present
defects.expected: The present is clearly held in Santa's hand
